title: Forward-Deployed AI Engineer
description: div class= content-intro h1 span style= font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; strong span style= font-size: 24pt; About Turing /span /strong /span /h1 p span id= m_-1033525666082252048m_-8288224233410703305gmail-docs-internal-guid-39386146-7fff-394b-7c89-9e58d80485b6 Turing’s mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end-to-end agentic AI systems inside mission-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at a href= http://www.turing.com/ target= _blank data-saferedirecturl= https://www.google.com/url?q=http://www.turing.com amp;source=gmail amp;ust=1788032823652000 amp;usg=AOvVaw2LLfe9HeuAcQz5ewoGP-0C www.turing.com /a . nbsp; /span /p div nbsp; /div /div p strong Role: /strong Forward-Deployed AI Engineer — Enterprise AI br strong Location: /strong Bengaluru, India br strong Experience Level: /strong 8+ years br strong Work Model: /strong Hybrid, 3 days per week in office /p h2 Why Join Enterprise AI? /h2 p Enterprise AI is a distinct business unit within Turing, operating with the speed, focus, and ownership of a rapidly scaling startup. When it comes to applied AI in the workplace, you’ll define the frontier by building beyond it. /p p You’ll join the initial team of Forward-Deployed Engineers, shaping how we work while solving enterprise-grade problems for the world’s leading enterprises. As a Forward-Deployed AI Engineer, you’ll own outcomes end to end—from identifying high-value customer problems and shaping architecture to building production systems and working directly with senior client leaders. /p p You’ll develop generative AI solutions in the real world, driving measurable impact and return on investment within large institutions. Enterprise AI is intense, intellectually challenging work. It won’t be for everyone, but it may be strong exactly the challenge you’re looking for. /strong /p h2 As a Forward-Deployed Engineer, You Will /h2 h3 Find the Problem Worth Solving /h3 p Work directly with customers to navigate ambiguity, uncover high-value opportunities, challenge assumptions, and translate complex business needs into clear technical direction. This requires curiosity and business acumen as you discover business workflows and jointly define the outcomes an AI solution should drive. /p h3 Build Beyond the Frontier /h3 p Architect and build production AI systems, from multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, context engineering, memory and state, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to the APIs, data pipelines, integrations, and distributed systems that make them reliable at scale. /p h3 Own the Outcome /h3 p You won’t simply be given a list of responsibilities—you’ll have the authority to own the outcome for your client and make a real-world impact through your work. You’ll lead solutions from discovery through deployment and measurable impact while staying hands-on and owning evaluation, observability, security, reliability, latency, scalability, and cost. /p h2 The Anti-Sell /h2 p strong High ownership and intensity: /strong This role requires exceptional ownership and accountability. You’ll work with clients who have uncompromising expectations for quality, making this a demanding environment—and an ideal proving ground for people who seek difficult, high-impact challenges. /p p strong Client-first and hybrid: /strong This role is based in Bengaluru or Hyderabad and requires working from the office three days per week. Candidates must currently be based in one of these two cities. Relocation assistance is not available. /p p strong You’ll help write the playbook: /strong Enterprise AI operates like a startup. You may not always have an established process or playbook because you’ll be expected to apply your expertise, judgment, and technical depth to create one. /p h2 Our Forward-Deployed Engineers Typically Have /h2 p strong Deep production engineering experience: /strong Typically 8+ years building and operating sophisticated software systems, with expertise in Python, backend systems, APIs, databases, distributed systems, system design, and cloud infrastructure. /p p strong Hands-on agentic AI experience: /strong Experience building production LLM and agent systems using orchestration, tool use, context engineering, memory and state, retrieval, and multistep workflows. /p p strong Strong retrieval depth: /strong Experience building and improving production retrieval systems, with a practical understanding of embeddings, vector and hybrid search, reranking, evaluation, and diagnosing retrieval quality. /p p strong End-to-end systems ownership: /strong A track record of taking complex systems from architecture through deployment and scale, with a practical understanding of evaluation, observability, reliability, security, guardrails, latency, scalability, and cost. /p p strong Exceptional customer and technical leadership: /strong The ability to enter unfamiliar environments, earn trust quickly, navigate ambiguity, challenge assumptions constructively, and communicate effectively with senior engineers and business executives. /p p strong Client-ready communication: /strong The ability to explain technical concepts clearly, navigate ambiguity, work with stakeholders, and remain calm under pressure. /p p nbsp; /p div c
